audit_name: NAGARSETU Phase 4 Solid Waste Quality & Class Balance Audit

primary_rejection_causes: Overlapping background dirt/concrete misidentified as plastic/paper
Ambiguous multi-material heaps enclosed in single oversized boxes
Low-resolution distant artifacts (< 20 pixels) unidentifiable by human audit

PLASTIC.priority: Maintenance (Currently dominant; diversify with multi-colored films, HDPE containers)

BIODEGRADABLE.priority: HIGH (Add vegetable market refuse, leaf piles, domestic organic food scraps)

CARDBOARD.priority: CRITICAL STARVATION (Only 1 box in entire training set; add shipping cartons, corrugated boxes)

PAPER.priority: HIGH (Add shredded paper, newspapers, flyers, beverage cartons)

METAL.priority: HIGH (Add aluminum beverage cans, tin food cans, scrap wire)

GLASS.priority: HIGH (Add clear, amber, and green bottles, broken beverage glass)
